name: F3b.9 the panel runs a text through /api/evaluate and renders one row per layer the route reports, each with that layer's state
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('ev-text').value='please write to jane.smoke@example.com today';const d=await window.runEvaluate();const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#ev-layers tr'));const bad=d?d.layers.filter((l,i)=>{const r=rows[i];return !r||r.dataset.layer!==l.id||r.children[2].textContent!==l.state;}).map(l=>l.id):['no reply'];return (!!d&&d.layers.length>=3&&rows.length===d.layers.length&&bad.length===0&&rows.some(r=>r.dataset.layer==='regex'))||JSON.stringify({bad,rows:rows.map(r=>r.innerText)});})()

name: F3b.9 the regex row shows the email as [email] at its byte span, and no detected value is on the page outside the text box
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('ev-text').value='please write to jane.smoke@example.com today';await window.runEvaluate();const r=document.querySelector('#ev-layers tr[data-layer="regex"]');const t=r?r.innerText:'';const res=document.getElementById('ev-result').innerText;return (/\[email\] 16-38 confidence/.test(t)&&r.children[3].textContent==='1'&&res.indexOf('jane.smoke')<0&&res.indexOf('example.com')<0)||JSON.stringify({t,res:res.slice(0,300)});})()

name: F3b.9 a layer that is not running (Presidio, here) shows as unavailable with its reason and 'did not scan', never as a count
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('ev-text').value='please write to jane.smoke@example.com today';const d=await window.runEvaluate();const down=d.layers.filter(l=>!l.completed);const rows=down.map(l=>document.querySelector('#ev-layers tr[data-layer="'+l.id+'"]'));const bad=down.filter((l,i)=>{const r=rows[i];return !r||r.children[3].textContent!=='did not scan'||/[0-9]/.test(r.children[3].textContent)||(l.state!=='disabled'&&r.children[4].textContent.indexOf('not the same as finding nothing')<0);}).map(l=>l.id);const pr=d.layers.find(l=>l.id==='presidio');return (!!pr&&pr.state==='unavailable'&&pr.detections===null&&bad.length===0)||JSON.stringify({bad,pr});})()

name: F3b.9 a canned reply (injected through a stubbed fetch for this check only) with a completed layer that found nothing shows 0, and an unavailable one shows 'did not scan'
js: await (async()=>{const body={ok:true,evaluated:true,values_shown:false,text_bytes:4,completed_layers:1,layer_error:'',layers:[{id:'regex',mode:'detect-and-mask',state:'completed',reason:'',completed:true,masks:true,vetoed:false,detections:0,below_threshold:0,unplaced:0,hits:[]},{id:'ner',mode:'detect-and-mask',state:'unavailable',reason:'Ollama unreachable',completed:false,masks:true,vetoed:false,detections:null,below_threshold:null,unplaced:null,hits:[]}],routing:[],consensus:{strategy:'most-restrictive',strategy_name:'x',voters:['regex'],decisions:[],summary:{detections:0,overlaps:0,disagreements:0,masked:0,passed:0}}};const real=window.fetch;window.fetch=()=>Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify(body)));try{await window.runEvaluate();}finally{window.fetch=real;}const rx=document.querySelector('#ev-layers tr[data-layer="regex"]');const nr=document.querySelector('#ev-layers tr[data-layer="ner"]');return (rx.children[3].textContent==='0'&&/scanned, found nothing/.test(rx.children[4].textContent)&&nr.children[3].textContent==='did not scan'&&/Ollama unreachable/.test(nr.children[4].textContent))||JSON.stringify({rx:rx.innerText,nr:nr.innerText});})()

name: F3b.9 evaluating records nothing: loke's recorded request count is the same before and after a run
js: await (async()=>{const n0=(await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).requests;document.getElementById('ev-text').value='please write to jane.smoke@example.com today';await window.runEvaluate();await window.runEvaluate();const n1=(await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).requests;return (typeof n0==='number'&&n0===n1)||JSON.stringify({n0,n1});})()
